attrs.AccelBrakeTiltNotes: Positive/negative pitch direction may depend on the live vehicle orientation. If acceleration or braking tilts the wrong way, flip the sign of the matching degrees value.
attrs.SpeedDisplayLowMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe: Makes the HUD speed read closer to (or above) the real speed near a standstill. 1 shows the real speed.
attrs.SpeedDisplayFullMph_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the real speed at which the HUD reaches its full high-speed multiplier higher, so the HUD reads low over more of the range.
attrs.InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.
attrs.SpeedDisplayHighMultiplier_RaisingThisDo: Makes the HUD speed read higher at SpeedDisplayFullMph and above. 1 shows the real speed.
attrs.SteeringCoastReverseMph_RaisingThisDoes: Requires a faster backward roll, with no throttle held and no reverse asked for, before steering switches to reverse.
attrs.SteeringCoastAssumeForward_Description: True: with no throttle held the car steers as if going forwards, unless the player was reversing and is still rolling back, or it rolls back faster than SteeringCoastReverseMph. False: the earlier rule (any backward drift over SteeringCoastDirectionMph steers as reverse).
attrs.DriftMiniBoostNotes: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.
attrs.SpeedDisplayCurveEnabled_Description: True: the HUD speed reads lower than the real speed at low speed and higher at high speed. Display only.
attrs.SpeedSteeringNotes: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.
attrs.SlopeHoverNotes: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

attrs.DriftTuningNote: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.
attrs.AccelerationTuningNote: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.
attrs.BoostTuningNote: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.
attrs.OrganisedTuningNote: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.
attrs.TuningNote: Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics. Disable Enabled for immediate legacy-force rollback.
attrs.HandlingTuningNote: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

attrs.LaunchRampEndMph_RaisingThisDoes: Extends the softer launch section to a higher speed.
attrs.WeightAccelerationMinMultiplier_RaisingT: Improves the worst acceleration multiplier for heavy vehicles.
attrs.DragReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires a higher Drag stat to reach the neutral air-resistance point.
attrs.EngineOutputExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens acceleration differences between weak and powerful engines.
attrs.BaseForwardAcceleration_RaisingThisDoes: Increases forward acceleration across the speed range.

attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMinMultiplier: Raises the duration floor for low-duration boost modules.

attrs.BalanceDriftTurnExtraShare_RaisingThisDo: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off the extra turning a drift gives, so drifts take corners wider.
attrs.BalanceReverseBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off reverse acceleration.
attrs.BalanceTopSpeedBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off top speed.
attrs.BalanceMiniBoostExtraShare_RaisingThisDo: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off the drift mini-boost push.
attrs.BalanceHighNerf_RaisingThisDoes: Nerfs the fastest cars more. 0.25 = 25 percent base nerf at BalanceHighPerformanceIndex.
attrs.BalanceAccelerationBaseShare_RaisingThis: Takes more of the base nerf off forward acceleration.
attrs.BalanceDriftTurnBaseShare_RaisingThisDoe: Takes more of the base nerf off the extra turning a drift gives (on top of the steering share).
attrs.BalanceBoostBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off the held boost push.
attrs.BalanceDriftAlignmentExtraShare_RaisingT: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off that momentum pull, so drifts carry wider.
attrs.BalanceDriftAlignmentBaseShare_RaisingTh: Takes more of the base nerf off the pull that swings momentum round to where the car points in a drift.
attrs.BalanceDriftChargeExtraShare_RaisingThis: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off how fast a drift charges its mini-boost.
attrs.BalanceBrakingExtraShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of BalanceAccelBrakeExtraNerf off braking.
attrs.BalanceAccelerationExtraShare_RaisingThi: Takes more of BalanceAccelBrakeExtraNerf off forward acceleration.
attrs.BalanceReverseExtraShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of BalanceAccelBrakeExtraNerf off reverse acceleration.
attrs.BalanceRefreshSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Makes edits to this folder take longer to reach a car being driven (the multipliers are recomputed this often). No effect on feel.
attrs.BalanceDriftEngineAssistBaseShare_Raisin: Takes more of the base nerf off the extra engine push while drifting.
attrs.BalanceGripBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off normal (non-drift) sideways grip, so cars slide wider in fast corners.
attrs.BalanceBoostExtraShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of BalanceAccelBrakeExtraNerf off the held boost push. At 1 boosted top speed falls by the same share as normal top speed.
attrs.BalanceHighPerformanceIndex_RaisingThisD: Moves the end of the curve up: cars at or above this PerformanceIndex get BalanceHighNerf, so cars below it are nerfed less.
attrs.BalanceBrakingBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off braking.
attrs.BalanceEnabled_RaisingThisDoes: 1 turns the performance balance nerf on. 0 turns all of it off (every multiplier becomes 1).
attrs.BalanceDriftChargeBaseShare_RaisingThisD: Takes more of the base nerf off how fast a drift charges its mini-boost.
attrs.BalanceAccelBrakeExtraNerf_RaisingThisDo: Extra nerf on top of the base nerf for acceleration, braking and boost push (each scaled by its ExtraShare).
attrs.BalanceSteeringBaseShare_RaisingThisDoes: Takes more of the base nerf off turn rate (all steering, drifting included).
attrs.BalanceCurveEase_RaisingThisDoes: Bends the line between the low and high nerf into an S: 0 is a straight line, 1 is flat at both ends and steepest in the middle.
attrs.BalanceDriftSideForceExtraShare_RaisingT: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off the drift slide-out push. Raising it makes drifts slide out less (tidier, not weaker).
attrs.BalanceFallbackPerformanceIndex_RaisingT: PerformanceIndex assumed for a vehicle that has none. Raising it nerfs such vehicles more.
attrs.BalanceDriftEngineAssistExtraShare_Raisi: Takes more of BalanceDriftExtraNerf off the extra engine push while drifting, so drifts lose more speed.
attrs.BalanceDragCoupling_RaisingThisDoes: 1 retunes air drag so real top speed falls by exactly the top speed nerf and no more. 0 leaves drag alone, so the acceleration nerf also lowers top speed further.
attrs.BalanceDriftExtraNerf_RaisingThisDoes: Extra nerf on top of the base nerf for drifting (each drift value scaled by its ExtraShare).
attrs.BalanceLowPerformanceIndex_RaisingThisDo: Moves the start of the curve up: cars at or below this PerformanceIndex get BalanceLowNerf.
attrs.BalanceLowNerf_RaisingThisDoes: Nerfs the slowest cars more. 0.10 = 10 percent base nerf at BalanceLowPerformanceIndex.
attrs.BalanceMiniBoostBaseShare_RaisingThisDoe: Takes more of the base nerf off the drift mini-boost push.
attrs.BalanceDriftSideForceBaseShare_RaisingTh: Takes more of the base nerf off the drift slide-out push. At 1 the slide angle stays about the same as speeds drop.

attrs.SettleRestScale_RaisingThisDoes: Rest height as a fraction of HoverHeightStuds. Raising it makes the stopped car sit higher (1 = no lowering).
attrs.ParkedExitDipStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Size of the small dip when the driver gets out. Raising it makes the car bob down further on exit. 0 = none.
attrs.SettleStartMph_RaisingThisDoes: Speed below which the car is fully lowered. Raising it keeps the car down for longer as it pulls away.
attrs.SettleThrottleDeadzone_RaisingThisDoes: Throttle needed before the throttle rise starts. Raising it ignores light trigger presses.
attrs.SettleThrottleLift_RaisingThisDoes: How far the car rises the moment the throttle is pressed, as a fraction of the full rise. 0 = rise from speed only.
attrs.BankLiftEnabled_Description: On: the car rises as it leans so the low side stays out of the ground. Off: no lift and no minimum clearance.
attrs.ParkedAnchoredPresentationEnabled_Descri: On: the parked (anchored) car is posed locally at the lowered rest height with a calm sway and bob. Off: it is left exactly where the server placed it.
attrs.DebugAttributes_Description: On: writes HoverPoseRideHeight, HoverPoseSettle and HoverPoseLift on the vehicle each frame for tuning. Leave off in normal play.
attrs.BankLiftLeadSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: How far ahead of the lean the lift looks. Raising it makes the car start rising earlier as you turn in.
attrs.BankLiftRiseHz_RaisingThisDoes: How quickly the lift comes in. Raising it makes the rise snappier.
attrs.BankLiftAmount_RaisingThisDoes: Share of the height the low side loses in a lean that is given back as lift. Raising it lifts the car more in turns and drifts (0 = only the minimum clearance).
attrs.SettleFullHeightMph_RaisingThisDoes: Speed at which the car is back at full height. Raising it makes the sink start earlier when slowing and the rise finish later.
attrs.BankLiftFallHz_RaisingThisDoes: How quickly the car comes back down after a lean. Raising it makes it drop back sooner; lowering it makes it float down.
attrs.SettleDamping_RaisingThisDoes: Damping of the sink and rise. Raising it removes the bounce (1 = none); lowering it adds more bounces.
attrs.SettleEnabled_Description: On: the car sinks towards the ground at a standstill and rises with speed. Off: ride height stays at HoverHeightStuds.
attrs.SettleFrequencyHz_RaisingThisDoes: Speed of the sink and rise. Raising it makes the car drop and bounce faster and tighter.
attrs.BankLiftMaxStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Most the lean can raise the car. Raising it allows more lift on very wide cars.
attrs.LeanSpringCompensation_RaisingThisDoes: How much the four hover springs follow the lean instead of fighting it. 1 = springs hold the leaned pose; 0 = as before (low side pushed up, high side dropped).
attrs.MinEdgeClearanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Gap always kept under the lowest part of the body (measured on part boxes), including when lowered or pitched. Raising it lifts the car sooner near the ground. 0 = off.

attrs.WobbleAtSpeedSpeedBoost_RaisingThisDoes: How much faster the wobble runs at speed. Raising it makes the at-speed trace quicker and finer.
attrs.WobbleEnabled_Description: On: idle sway, bob and yaw drift. Off: the car holds still (driving and parked).
attrs.WobbleSmoothing_RaisingThisDoes: How closely the car follows the wobble pattern. Raising it makes the motion crisper; lowering it makes it lazier.
attrs.WobbleRollMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes: Side to side share of the sway. Raising it makes the car rock more.
attrs.ParkedWobbleScale_RaisingThisDoes: Size of the parked sway compared with idling in the seat. Raising it makes the parked car move more.
attrs.WobbleBobStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Up and down float at idle. Raising it makes the car bob further. 0 = none.
attrs.WobbleRandomiseAmount_RaisingThisDoes: Strength of the regular flutter layered on the slow drift. Raising it adds more quick movement.
attrs.ParkedWobbleSpeedScale_RaisingThisDoes: Speed of the parked sway compared with idling in the seat. Raising it makes the parked car move quicker.
attrs.WobbleRestBoost_RaisingThisDoes: Extra sway when fully stopped. Raising it makes a standing car look more alive. 0 = none.
attrs.WobbleAmountDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Size of the idle pitch and roll sway. Raising it makes the car rock further.
attrs.WobbleSpeed_RaisingThisDoes: Speed of all wobble motion. Raising it makes the sway and bob quicker.
attrs.WobbleFadeOutMph_RaisingThisDoes: Speed at which the idle sway has faded to its at-speed trace. Raising it keeps the sway for longer as you pull away.
attrs.WobbleAtSpeedAmount_RaisingThisDoes: Share of the sway kept at speed. Raising it keeps more movement while driving fast. 0 = fades out completely as before.
attrs.ParkedWobbleEnabled_Description: On: the parked car keeps a calm sway and bob after the driver gets out. Off: parked cars hold still.
attrs.WobbleDetailAmount_RaisingThisDoes: Strength of a second, faster layer so the sway never looks repeated. 0 = the old single layer.
attrs.WobbleYawDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Slow nose left and right drift at idle (never at speed). Raising it makes the car wander more. 0 = none.
attrs.WobblePitchMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes: Nose up and down share of the sway. Raising it makes the car nod more.
attrs.WobbleRestMph_RaisingThisDoes: Speed below which the standstill boost applies. Raising it keeps the boost while creeping.
